interface.Practise before you travel. At the Haram: Tababaro ka hor safarka. Markaad Xaramka joogto, raac tallaabo kasta oo ka sii wad halkii aad ku joogsatay.
interface.Rehearse all seven stages with a short c: Ku tababaro toddobada marxaladood, su’aal gaabanna ka jawaab marxalad kasta.
interface.Lost count, separated from family or loo: Tiradii ma illowday, qoyskaagii ma kala lunteen, mise waxaad raadinaysaa jid si fudud loo mari karo?
interface.Check your phone and choose a Saudi data: Hubi taleefankaaga oo dooro xirmo internet oo Sacuudiga ka shaqaysa ka hor intaadan bixin.
interface.When you are ready, start your live guid: Markaad diyaar noqoto, fur hagaha cumrada. Tirinta tababarka iyo tan cumradu way kala gaar yihiin.
interface.You have marked all seven stages complet: Waxaad qalabkan ku calaamadisay in toddobada marxaladoodba ay dhammaadeen.
interface.Review final stage: Dib u eeg marxaladda u dambaysa
interface.Practice only. This rehearsal does not p: Waa tababar keliya. Tababarkani ma aha gudashada cibaadada.
interface.Where each trip ends: Halka uu maris kastaa ku dhammaado
interface.No matching guidance. Ask mosque staff f: Wax tilmaam ah lama helin. Shaqaalaha masaajidka weydii halka laga helo talo diineed.
interface.Yesim sells data-only plans. Check your: Yesim waxay iibisaa xirmooyin internet oo keliya. Ka hor lacag bixinta, hubi nooca taleefanka iyo inuu u furan yahay shirkado kale.
interface.Choose Saudi Arabia, data allowance and: Dooro Sacuudiga, mugga internetka iyo muddada. Yesim ka hubi qiimaha ugu dambeeya iyo tilmaamaha hawlgelinta.
interface.View Saudi plans on Yesim: Ka eeg xirmooyinka Sacuudiga ee Yesim
interface.External retailer. This preview uses a d: Iibiye dibadeed. Noocan tijaabada ahi wuxuu isticmaalaa xiriir toos ah oo aan lahayn summad komishan.
interface.Storage unavailable. Keep this page open: Kaydintu ma shaqaynayso. Boggan ha xirmin.
